text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — /v1/generate 5xx spike in apac-east. rolling 5m error rate 18% (threshold 5%). deploy=r-2026-0315-variant-swap. Please ack and investigate.

Devon: Acked. I'm on-call, looking at the staged variant swap that ran at 03:15 UTC.

Maria: I'm checking the rollout dashboard — we started traffic-shift to model-variant embed-v2-quant at 03:15:12 UTC. Canary saw elevated 503s right after.

Devon: Logs show a sudden surge of 503s with the error "kv cache panic" in the new variant. grabbing logs now.

Samir: Heads-up — this variant had experimental kv cache changes and a different kernel selection path.

Devon: Snippet from apac-node-7:```
[2026-03-15T03:18:02Z] request_id=abc123 status=503 model=embed-v2-quant latency=120ms error=\"kv cache miss panic\"
[2026-03-15T03:18:03Z] request_id=abc124 status=200 model=embed-stable latency=45ms
```

Devon: i'm going to hold traffic back and flip the variant flag to force stable. executing ff toggle now.

Devon: ```
# ffctl --env prod toggle use-new-embed-variant off --by=Devon
Success: flag use-new-embed-variant -> off
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag change recorded: use-new-embed-variant = off by Devon @ 2026-03-15T03:20:14Z

Jonah: On it — can we divert traffic away from apac-east to apac-west stable pool while we confirm?

Maria: Yes. Starting traffic steer to stable pool (apac-west) with 90% weight.```
# routingctl steer region=apac-east -> apac-west weight=90%
```

Devon: Traffic shift initiated. watching error rate.

incident-bot: Update: 5xx rate reduced to 4.2% in rolling 5m after flag toggle and steer.

Elsa: Support update — we've started an incident note for affected customers. Early telemetry shows ~12 paid customers saw increased error rates during 03:15-03:20 UTC window. Opening tickets.

Samir: I'm going to roll back the deployment record for the variant swap to be safe. plan: mark r-2026-0315 as rolled-back and re-deploy stable.

Devon: Command for rollback executed: ```
# deployctl rollback r-2026-0315 --reason="kv-cache panic in embed-v2-quant" --by=Devon
OK: rollback initiated, target nodes draining
```

Jonah: I'm taking the pager from Devon — Devon stepping off-call in 10m. I'll monitor until stabilized and then do a formal handoff.

Devon: thanks — leaving notes: suspected root cause is new kv-cache path combined with long-tail requests causing mutex contention, resulting in panic and 503s on that variant.

Jonah: Acknowledged. I'll keep traffic steering until all nodes on r-2026-0315 are drained.

incident-bot: Customer impact update: estimated affected requests ~1.2k over 5m window, ~0.6% of global traffic. Severity: P2 (multiple paid customers affected, degraded UX).

Elsa: Support posted a status update to the status page and alerted account teams for top 5 customers. Reference ticket: INC-20260315-embed.

Maria: I've collected heap and kernel traces from the failing node and uploaded to the diagnostics bucket: gs://redwood-diagnostics/2026-03-15/embed-variant/trace-2971112222.tar.gz

Samir: Assigning postmortem owner: Samir (prodops). Timeline + actions will be prepared.

Jonah: Current state: traffic + error rate stable, rollback completed on all affected nodes, routing weight back to normal. I'm going to run a final verification suite across apac regions.

Jonah: Verification results: 0/50 simulated requests failing, p95 latency within normal.

Devon: Thanks team. I'll add configs to disallow kernel-selection path for that variant until a fix is validated.

incident-bot: Incident closed for pager window. Summary: variant swap r-2026-0315 caused kv-cache panic -> 5xx spike; flag toggled off; traffic steered; rollback executed; customers notified; postmortem owner: Samir.

Samir: Postmortem ETA 48h. Immediate mitigations: revert variant, add circuit breaker on kv-cache panic, add canary query load test for kv path.

Elsa: I'll coordinate customer post-incident follow-ups and share timeline with account managers.

Jonah: Handoff complete. Devon back on standby. I'll update the oncall log with timeline entries.

Devon: thx all.
